notes.title: The Roles Update
notes.notes:
[ [b]Abilities[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Abilities no longer display their cooldown in the top right.
[*] Abilities that are used each night now read "Each night" instead of "At night".

[b]Before[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/f0fba31d41e3b52ea17f710a24f3e95d6c8af7d6.jpg[/img]

[b]After[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/059948f0899874e30af7324ef3b58f161321eff1.png[/img]

[*] Role resources (such as mana) now display properly on the role screen.
[*] Ability resource costs now display correctly on abilities.

[b]Before[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ae3f6358921257002616562a01b6d8e44635ac20.jpg[/img]
[b]After[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/73801db6447e6e094df8a6e4418b38781bb75acc.png[/img]

[*] Added a new ability type, Ultimate, which can be used once per game.

[b]Before[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/18f51644c95aaa26f1a13a5c636df3f1d5367072.jpg[/img]

[b]After[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/411a291dcf2c957430ce7431ef638af6a5d95121.png[/img]
[/list]

[ [b]Role Updates[/b] ]
[list]
[*]The Wolf Girl no longer learns capability. Now learns who their target targets at night.
[*]The Greenhorn no longer has permanent defense, reveals someone on death and now only leaves someone bleeding instead of dead on death.
[/list]

[ [b]User Interface[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Added icons for Faction and Class on the role screen.
[*] Role resources now display properly on the role screen.
[/list]

[ [b]Nametags[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Nametags now display as the colour of your faction when talking.
[*] To a Townsfolk, all nametags display as blue (as if everyone else is Town).
[*] To a Werewolf, all nametags display as blue, but their fellow Werewolves display as red.
[*] To a Game Host, all nametags display as their true faction's colour.
[/list]

[ [b]Roles [/b] ] 

Added 13 new roles. Please welcome:

The [b]Judge[/b] 
Starting the game revealed he completely changes the way that lynch votes operate during the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/7fa992519fe71bc6236dd99e71693dd31bf6eb6e.jpg[/img]

The [b]Old Man[/b] 
An innocent old man who's quite happy to have a nice long chat with the first person who visits him at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/8e3d2cdcd9ca0bb0bf10797572b7589156b24606.jpg[/img]

The [b]Locksmith[/b]
Protects people by locking them inside their houses at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/1efa4dd710e71ee42f281fedd03e4b998a51a06a.jpg[/img]

The [b]Grave Digger[/b]
Steal the identity of others by exuming their bodies at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/83b20572fb93447465fa739245a0a211e2fe851b.jpg[/img]

The [b]Chronomancer[/b]
Protect Town by bending time, allowing more time to react to attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/2b00f397d7ef097f12975976bcec49ff241fd596.jpg[/img]

[b]Death[/b] himself
Harvests the souls of the living.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/6a7a21c94516c2de1ef5a21a66cf67a77db74863.jpg[/img]

The [b]Night Owl[/b] 
Stays awake at night, learning all that happens to her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/9f7228ca89f04e4855d3a3c31bd886d2499add7b.jpg[/img]

The [b]Den Mother[/b] 
Keeps all other Werewolves safe at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/4e7ee3a8beba7e771321b19db68bb024586260f8.jpg[/img]

The [b]Forger[/b] 
Has complete control of what is announced when players die at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/99b5ade7c5a7087bcd123761c40c4be82064fad3.jpg[/img]

The [b]Skeletal Wolf[/b] 
Leaves players and himself fragile at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/fd7d026d4d81c56ebb87ccba1ea1c5787b68ad41.jpg[/img]

The [b]Fallen Star[/b] 
An Evil who wins by delaying the game and keeping everyone else alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/cfe464da63c73f65b41135455d683db2f9d07918.jpg[/img]

The [b]Werewolf Scholar[/b] 
Learns the capability of othere players, allowing the Werewolves to attack priority targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/cb99360b242d96dee5e228f51a8dfd101bb6d466.jpg[/img]
